hook: 'Par maine toh kiwaad kab ka khol diya...'
feedback: Solid, gripping execution! The cold open trick (cut 1 jumps straight to the twist/sting, cut 2 pulls back to reset the clock) works exceptionally well for Instagram retention. The eerie double motif using Fazilka's freezing borderland fog is grounded and deeply atmospheric. Dialogue formatting (Devanagari with inline English terms like 'screen' and 'message') matches the target voice perfectly. LENGTH: about 62s; it must be 40-52s (roughly 80-104 spoken words).
lines: 'Par maine toh kiwaad kab ka khol diya...'
Raat ke do bajkar pandrah minute par Simran ki saansen tham gayi!
Fazilka ke is purane farmhouse mein kadake ki thand aur batti gul thi.
Simran andheri rasoi mein neeli lau par garma-garam chai bana rahi thi.
Tabhi peeche se pati Karan ne aakar usse baahon mein bhar liya...
Thithurte hue usne chai ka cup thaam liya aur bahar kohre ko ghoorne laga.
Achanak slab par pade phone ki screen chamak uthi.
Karan ka message tha— 'Car highway par fhansi hai, rasoi ka pichhla darwaza mat kholna!'
Simran ne dekha... rasoi ka pichhla kiwaad poora khula hua tha!
Peeche khade saaye ne cup neeche rakha aur uske kaan ke paas jhuk gaya...
Raat ko agar bina aahat koi tumhe peeche se gale laga le, toh bina chehra dekhe muskurana mat.
